cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our cakes tied. Next round, blindfolded icing. Loser cleans the kitchen. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then it should survive a more informative test.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want another cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can compete over who persuades the other to bake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our cakes tied. Next round, blindfolded icing. Loser cleans the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should survive a more informative test.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want another cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can compete over who persuades the other to bake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why should anyone lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We both enjoyed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Six losses! Our comeback will need its own documentary. Please.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then the documentary opens next season.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our team is disbanding.

beats.text: A reunion comeback. You've just improved the second act.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Congratulations on the prize. Such a lovely year for forgiving judges. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'm saying they saw past things I couldn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm saying they saw past things I couldn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful promotion. Your timing with the director's retirement was beautiful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I worked for this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how considerate of the vacancy to arrive when you were ready.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm choosing the most generous version available this morning.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?
